title: Filtered Burgers yields the exact LES subgrid-stress identity tau_sgs = mean(u^2) - (mean u)^2 as the forced closure rewrite term
one_sentence_claim_original: SBT's route-mismatch primitive (lens-only commutator of a translation-invariant filter with the Burgers nonlinear flux) reproduces, as an exact algebraic identity, the canonical LES subgrid-stress term tau_sgs = bar(u^2) - (bar u)^2, which vanishes for linear dynamics and grows with filter width sigma.
target_known_fact: Filtering a nonlinear advection equation does not commute with the nonlinear flux: for filtered Burgers the closed filtered equation acquires the subgrid-stress term tau_sgs = bar(u^2) - (bar u)^2 (Leonard 1974 / Germano 1992 decomposition; eddy-viscosity closure tradition of Smagorinsky 1963). It is identically zero for linear dynamics and grows with filter width.
scientific_domain: Fluid dynamics / turbulence closure (statistical mechanics of coarse-graining)
derivability_class: A (in the narrow sense 'exact algebraic-identity match', NOT mechanized theorem and NOT derivation of a nontrivial physical fact)

repair.summary: Survives as an honestly-scoped RECOVERY / dictionary cross-walk. Repairs applied are all allowed (narrow claim, split 'exact' from approximate, clarify P3->P1 mapping, restrict to 1D scalar, add scope caveats already present in the source papers). No forbidden moves were needed; the candidate already conceded its limits in honest_status_note. Independent verification reproduced the load-bearing facts.
allowed_repairs_applied: REPLACE EXACT WITH SCOPED-EXACT: The word 'exact algebraic identity' is restricted to the CONTINUOUS PDE identity tau_sgs = bar(u^2)-(bar u)^2 (verified residual ~1e-14, independent of sigma/nu/kernel/field). The finite-RK4 'route mismatch' table (RMS of bar(T_tau u) - T_tau(bar u), paper Fig/Table 1, line 616) is reported SEPARATELY as an O(dt)-approximate stepper-dependent diagnostic. Independently verified: at dt=0.002 the one-step route mismatch matches dt*d_x(tau_sgs/2) only to leading order, with a ~2x higher-order residual (/tmp/route_vs_sgs.py: mismatch 2.01e-4, leading prediction 2.01e-4, residual 4.03e-4). The original one_sentence_claim folded the stepper-commutator sigma-growth into 'exact algebraic identity', mildly overselling; this is now split.

CLARIFY MAPPING (P3->P1): State plainly that the lens/dynamics noncommutation is the P3 route-mismatch DIAGNOSTIC, which DIAGNOSES (motivates) the P1 operator-rewrite term tau_sgs. This is exactly the paper's own linkage: To_Become_a_Stone line 132 'P1 (operator rewrite). When a macro evolution is not closed, route mismatch diagnoses the needed rewrite/correction term (e.g. LES subgrid term).' The forbidden move (treating P3 as a directionality/arrow certificate) is NOT made and must never be made.

NARROW CLAIM (dimension): Restrict the quantitative claim to the 1D scalar viscous Burgers case. The identification of the 1D scalar tau_sgs with the 3D tensor Germano/Leonard stress tau_ij = L_ij + C_ij + R_ij is an analogy of one component (cited at line ~516/839, NOT re-derived). Do not advertise reproduction of the full tensor L+C+R decomposition.

REMOVE/EXPOSE IMPLICIT ASSUMPTION (lens choice): State that the translation-invariant convolution filter is a CHOSEN lens (SBT has no canonical-lens principle; ledger missing_interfaces 'No rule selecting the lens f'). It is selected precisely so the filter commutes with derivatives and the viscous term, localizing the obstruction onto the single term tau_sgs. Variable-width LES filters do NOT commute with derivatives (Ghosal-Moin 1995, Vasilyev 2000) and add a commutation-error term not captured here. This is the standard LES filter assumption, not SBT-specific tuning, but it is an input matched to the known answer.

ADD SCOPE CAVEATS (honoring disclaimers): (i) NOT Lean-certified for the PDE -- To_Become_a_Stone app:lean line 923 verbatim 'These Lean results are not intended to formalize the quantum or PDE examples'; the backbone (commutes_of_factorsThrough, section_uniform, TV_Q_f_le) covers only the equal-fiber partition lens Prod.fst on finite PMFs. 'Class A' = exact-identity match only. (ii) SBT supplies NO closure model, NO Smagorinsky/eddy-viscosity coefficient, NO continuum/Navier-Stokes derivation (abstract line 62: 'We do not derive continuum theories'). (iii) Lens-only regime: there is NO completion U_f (line 524). (iv) The sigma=0 / linear-dynamics null gate is a code REGRESSION certificate (line 856), not new empirical evidence.
forbidden_repairs_avoided: Did NOT add arbitrary assumptions or hidden tuning: the identity holds for ANY field/sigma/nu/kernel (verified), zero parameters affect it.
Did NOT hide imported physics: explicitly flags Leonard 1974 / Germano 1992 / Smagorinsky 1963 as the source; imports_known_physics = true.
Did NOT claim unproven uniqueness, derivation, prediction, new physics, or Lean certification of the PDE.
Did NOT treat route mismatch (P3) as a directionality certificate (forbidden_moves ledger line 70; disclaimer line 136).
Did NOT use 'naturally emerges' language; the term is an algebraic add-and-subtract definition.

independent_verification.exact_identity: Reproduced /tmp/sgs_check.py and /tmp/sgs_verify.py: d_x(0.5 bar(u^2)) == d_x(0.5 (bar u)^2) + d_x(0.5 tau_sgs) to machine precision; max identity residual ~1.1e-14 to 1.97e-14 across sigma in {0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4}; sigma=0 residual exactly 0.0.
independent_verification.null_gate: sigma=0 gives max|tau_sgs| = 0.0 (sgs_check.py) / ~1.8e-15 (sgs_verify.py); linear-flux null bar(c*u)-c*bar(u) = 1.11e-15 to 1.33e-15. Genuine and verified.
independent_verification.monotone_sigma_scaling: max|tau_sgs| increases monotonically with sigma (e.g. 0.0535 -> 0.150 -> 0.263 -> 0.399 over sigma 0.05..0.4). Confirmed.
independent_verification.route_mismatch_vs_identity_separation: /tmp/route_vs_sgs.py: the finite-RK4 one-step route mismatch (2.01e-4) equals the leading algebraic prediction dt*d_x(tau_sgs/2) (2.01e-4) only to O(dt); the residual is 4.03e-4 (ratio ~2.0 to the mismatch). Confirms the two objects are NOT identical; 'exact' applies to the continuous identity, not the stepper table. This is the load-bearing repair.
independent_verification.paper_citations_confirmed: To_Become_a_Stone lines 524 (lens-only, no U_f), 535-540 (exact filtered equation + tau_sgs definition), 542 ('exactly the Six-Birds route mismatch at the PDE level'), 569 ('induces an exact algebraic correction term'), 132 (P1 rewrite diagnosed by route mismatch), 923 (Lean NOT for PDE), 856 (null gates = regression certificates), 1020 (defaults N=128, nu=0.1, dt=0.002, t_max=1.0). All verbatim-confirmed.

revised_one_sentence_claim: Applying SBT's P3 route-mismatch diagnostic (the lens-only commutator of a translation-invariant spatial filter with the Burgers nonlinear flux) to 1D viscous Burgers recovers, as an exact CONTINUOUS algebraic identity (verified residual ~1e-14), the canonical LES subgrid-stress term tau_sgs = bar(u^2) - (bar u)^2 -- the P1 operator-rewrite term it motivates -- which is identically zero for linear dynamics and grows monotonically with filter width sigma; this is a recovery of Leonard 1974 / Germano 1992 by definition, not a derivation, prediction, or Lean-certified theorem.
new_minimum_viable_result: A short reproducibility note (2-3 pages) plus one deterministic Python script that (i) instantiates filtered 1D viscous Burgers as an SBT lens-only package (filter = lens Q_f, no completion U_f, Burgers stepper = dynamics), (ii) verifies the CONTINUOUS exact identity tau_sgs = bar(u^2)-(bar u)^2 to machine precision (~1e-14) for arbitrary field/sigma/nu/kernel, (iii) reproduces the monotone sigma-scaling with the genuine sigma=0 / linear-dynamics null gate (=0), and (iv) reports the finite-RK4 route-mismatch table SEPARATELY as an O(dt)-approximate diagnostic that agrees with the algebraic term only to leading order. Framed and titled explicitly as a RECOVERY / dictionary cross-walk of Leonard 1974 / Germano 1992, with in-line glosses that (a) the SBT content is the relabeling 'P3 noncommutation diagnoses a P1 rewrite term', (b) it is NOT Lean-certified for the PDE (cite line 923), and (c) SBT supplies no closure model, coefficient, or continuum theorem.
changes_made: Split the headline: 'exact algebraic identity' now attaches only to the continuous PDE identity (verified ~1e-14); the finite-stepper route-mismatch table is reported separately as an O(dt)-approximate, stepper-dependent diagnostic (independently verified ~2x higher-order residual).
Reclassified the role labels: the commutator is the P3 route-mismatch DIAGNOSTIC that MOTIVATES the P1 operator-rewrite term tau_sgs (per paper line 132), never a directionality certificate.
Restricted the quantitative claim to 1D scalar Burgers; demoted the 1D-scalar-to-3D-tensor Germano L+C+R identification to an explicitly-labeled analogy (cited, not re-derived).

Exposed the chosen-lens assumption (translation-invariant filter selected to localize the obstruction onto one term; no canonical-lens principle; variable-width filters add an uncaptured commutation-error term).

Added the four scope caveats verbatim from the source: NOT Lean-certified for PDE (line 923); no closure model/coefficient/continuum derivation (abstract line 62); lens-only, no completion U_f (line 524); null gate is a code regression certificate (line 856).
Re-titled the deliverable as a RECOVERY / dictionary entry, with the verb 'reproduces' glossed in-line as 'recovers by definition (Leonard 1974 / Germano 1992)'.
Independently re-ran all four /tmp verification scripts to confirm the exact identity, null gate, monotone scaling, and the route-mismatch-vs-identity separation.
remaining_objections: FATAL-TO-DERIVATION-READING (but not to the recovery): The 'derivation' is a tautology -- tau_sgs = bar(u^2)-(bar u)^2 is the DEFINITION of the filtered nonlinear-flux residual, obtained by a single add-and-subtract of d_x(0.5 (bar u)^2). SBT contributes only the words 'route mismatch / P1 operator rewrite'. No new quantitative content. All four skeptics agree: is_actually_new = false.

BEATS NO BASELINE: SBT does strictly worse than the standard LES account on every contentful axis -- no closure model for tau_sgs, no Smagorinsky/dynamic-Smagorinsky coefficient, no L+C+R substress re-derivation, no continuum/Navier-Stokes convergence. beats_baseline = false. Strictly a RECOVERY of a 1963-1992 result.

TARGET LEAKAGE AT FRAMING LEVEL: the translation-invariant filter and the 1D Burgers surrogate were chosen precisely to land on the pre-known term; SBT has no canonical-lens principle and no completion U_f. target_used_to_design_theory = true (the theory framing imports the answer). Conceded, not hidden.

NOT LEAN-CERTIFIED FOR THE PDE: the existing finite-PMF backbone (commutes_of_factorsThrough, equal-fiber Prod.fst lens) explicitly does not cover the PDE (line 923). 'Class A' overstates verification status unless read narrowly as 'exact-identity match'.

INTERPRETIVE NARRATIVE IS POST-HOC-FLEXIBLE: the slogan 'noncommutation of coarse-graining with dynamics is THE universal source of effective correction terms' is reused across LES, gravitational backreaction (R025), and quantum route mismatch (R027); on its own it has high post-hoc applicability and predicts neither which term appears nor its coefficient. (The specific identity here is rigid; the surrounding story is not.)

OMITTED COMMUTATION-ERROR TERM: the construction silently assumes the filter commutes with derivatives; for general (variable-width / non-spectral) filters the actual LES literature carries a separate commutation-error term, which is not treated here.

score_rationale.impact: 1 -- recovers a 1963-1992 textbook identity by definition; supplies no model, coefficient, or continuum result. Zero new physics; a calibration/dictionary exhibit only.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 5 -- single afternoon; few hundred lines of numpy/FFT already prototyped (/tmp/sgs_check.py, residual ~1e-14). No new theory required.
score_rationale.plausibility: 5 -- the identity is true and machine-precision-verified; independently reproduced. Not in doubt.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 4 -- the LOAD-BEARING identity is algebraically rigid (zero free parameters affect it; could not have yielded the opposite null-gate or sign), and SBT packaging freedom is REDUCED here (no completion U_f). Docked from 5 because the lens and surrogate were chosen to match the known answer (target_used_to_design_theory = true) and the surrounding unifying narrative is post-hoc-flexible across >=2 facts.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1 -- the identity is forced by elementary algebra and holds independent of all SBT structure; it cannot distinguish SBT from textbook LES. A different (non-translation-invariant) lens would not give tau_sgs, so the 'success' is by construction. No non-definitional prediction the identity forbids.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4 -- turbulence/LES modelers and coarse-graining mathematicians will instantly recognize the Germano/Leonard term and the clean null gate; the cross-walk is clear. Docked because the SBT relabeling adds little they value and the P3/P1 labeling needs careful exposition.
score_rationale.precision: 2 -- the identity itself is sharp, but as a TEST of SBT it is near-vacuous (definitional); SBT's no-continuum / no-closure-model disclaimers cap the precision of any physical claim. The original 'exact' headline conflated the rigid continuous identity with the O(dt) stepper table.
score_rationale.robustness: 5 -- verified across sigma, kernels, fields, and grid; null gates pass exactly; identity residual ~1e-14 everywhere. Maximally robust as an algebraic fact.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 0 -- strictly a recovery; beats no baseline on any predictive axis; SBT supplies nothing the standard Leonard/Germano account does not already give for free.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2 -- publishable only as a short pedagogical reproducibility note / dictionary entry, or as one worked example inside the existing physics paper (where it already appears). Not a standalone research contribution; a Lean finite-difference certification (see stronger_result) would lift this.

bin_rationale: B (foundational sanity check). This is the single cleanest, most honest exhibit of what SBT's central noncommutation slogan delivers when pinned to a recognized physics result: a machine-precision-verifiable EXACT algebraic identity with a genuine null gate, zero free parameters in the identity, and reduced packaging freedom. It is the right calibration anchor for the whole route-mismatch family (R025 backreaction, R027 quantum) -- it shows the mechanism is literally true HERE while sharply delimiting that it is a definition, not a prediction. Not bin A (the MVR is already in the paper, so it is not a fresh quick win that adds content), not C/D/E (no flagship claim, no risky numerics, no new reframing), not F (it is verified, honest, and useful as a discipline on the other route-mismatch cards). The one upgrade path that would move it toward C is the Lean finite-difference certification (recommended_artifact).
recommended_priority: Medium-low. Do it as a short reproducibility note + script (one afternoon), primarily to anchor and discipline the more aggressive route-mismatch cards (R025, R027). The genuine value-add -- a Lean-certified circulant-filter / polynomial-stepper finite-difference commutator equal to the discrete tau_sgs, bringing the case under commutes_of_factorsThrough -- is a days-to-weeks moderate add and is the only thing that would raise it above recovery grade. Do NOT pursue the 3D Navier-Stokes / closure-coefficient extension (crosses SBT's disclaimed continuum boundary).
recommended_artifact: A short reproducibility note (2-3 pages) plus one deterministic Python script (already prototyped, /tmp/sgs_check.py) that (i) instantiates filtered 1D viscous Burgers as an SBT lens-only package, (ii) verifies the continuous exact identity to ~1e-14 and reproduces the monotone sigma table with the sigma=0 / linear-dynamics null gate, (iii) reports the finite-stepper route-mismatch table separately as an O(dt) diagnostic, and (iv) optionally a Lean stub certifying the discrete circulant-filter / polynomial-stepper commutator equals the discrete subgrid term (extending commutes_of_factorsThrough to the finite-difference Burgers case). Framed explicitly as a recovery / dictionary entry, never as a prediction.
